blocks.text: Botox, Dysport, and Jeuveau in Westlake Hills

blocks.html: Botox® is typically used to temporarily relax facial muscles, diminishing the appearance of wrinkles. It blocks some chemical signals from nerves in the treated area, preventing muscle contraction. This product, prepared from botulin, became so popular that for many it remains synonymous with the cosmetic treatment of wrinkles, frown lines, and fine lines around the eyes by relaxing facial muscles.

At Victory Medical, our Botox® treatments are safe. Our trained, experienced specialists in Austin will ensure the Botox® injectables are prepared and administered safely, according to FDA standards. This will help ensure that you experience minimal adverse effects following a Botox® treatment.

If you receive Botox® treatments from somewhere other than a certified medical center or spa, you increase the risk of adverse effects. These include allergic reactions, drooping eyelids, and uneven eyebrows. Not a good look if all you are trying to do is smooth out some wrinkles. This is why it makes sense to book with seasoned professionals who understand the product and how to apply it safely and effectively.

The term “Injectables” is a catchall term for several cosmetic treatments administered through injections. At the Victory MedSpa, our specialists offer a full array of the most effective and results-oriented injectables that tackle the effects of aging skin from many angles.
Have a look below at what each of our injectables can do for your skin. See something your skin needs? Schedule an appointment with the MedSpa today by going to our booking page to get started!

blocks.text: BOTOX INJECTIONS IN WESTLAKE HILLS WESTLAKE HILLS

blocks.html:
One of the more popularly known injections, Botox is approved for treating forehead lines and crow’s feet in addition to glabellar lines (frown lines around your eyebrows). Our treatments are non-invasive, painless, and require little to no recovery time. The number of units that are used on your skin depends on the desired results.

Want to know more about what your skin needs before you schedule an appointment? No problem! Call to schedule a consultation with the Victory MedSpa and they will tell you exactly what you need to know.

Dysport, often used in conjunction with Botox, reduces the appearance of lines that primarily affect the glabella, the area between your eyebrows. These lines extend upward, or vertically, toward the forehead and are most commonly known as “frown lines”. While naturally occurring, aging and collagen loss in the skin can affect these lines to be deeper, more promeninent, and noticeable even when your face is relaxed. Our Dysport injection aims to reverse those affects and to give your skin a smooth and relaxed look once again. Our treatments are non-invasive, painless, and require little to no recovery time. The number of units that are used on your skin depends on the desired results.

Want to know more about what your skin needs before you schedule an appointment? No problem! Call to schedule a consultation with the Victory MedSpa and they will tell you exactly what you need to know.

Jeuveau<sup>®</sup> is a prescription medicine, using Hi-Pure™ Technology, that is injected into muscles and used in adults for a short period of time to improve the look of moderate to severe frown lines between the eyebrows.
Jeuveau<sup>®</sup> dosing units are not the same as, or comparable to, any other botulinum.
